pictures.scene: El Greco, The Repentant Saint Peter — the old apostle with his hands locked together and his wet eyes turned up to heaven, for the choirmaster with stringed instruments of David, hear my cry O God
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_the_repentant_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Eduard Bendemann, Jews Mourning in Exile — the chained old man with his harp set down beside him and a child clinging to his knee, attend to my prayer, from the ends of the earth I call out to You
pictures.name: pd_bendemann_jews_mourning_in_exile

pictures.scene: Washington Allston, Elijah in the Desert — the prophet lying worn out among the dead trees while the ravens bring him food, whenever my heart is faint, lead me to the rock
pictures.name: pd_allston_elijah_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Joseph Anton Koch, The Schmadribach Falls — one small herdsman standing under a rock wall and snowfield that fill the whole sky, that is higher than I, for You have been my refuge
pictures.name: pd_koch_the_schmadribach_falls

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, The Château de Chillon — the castle and its towers standing up out of the lake with the water all around the walls, a tower of strength against the enemy, let me dwell in Your tent forever
pictures.name: pd_courbet_the_chateau_de_chillon

pictures.scene: Andrei Mironov, Guardian Angel — a child drawn in under the angel's great wing and held there, and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings, Selah
pictures.name: pd_mironov_guardian_angel

pictures.scene: Govert Flinck, Isaac Blessing Jacob — the blind old father laying his hand on the son's head to give him the blessing, for You have heard my vows O God, You have given me the inheritance
pictures.name: pd_flinck_isaac_blessing_jacob

pictures.scene: Gerrit Dou, Old Woman Reading a Lectionary — the old woman holding the heavy book open and bent close over the page, reserved for those who fear Your name, increase the days of the king's life
pictures.name: pd_dou_old_woman_reading_a_lectionary

pictures.scene: Guercino, King David — the crowned king seated with his scepter, leaning on a stone cut with the words of his own psalm, may his years span many generations, may he sit enthroned in God's presence forever
pictures.name: pd_guercino_king_david

pictures.scene: Workshop of Andrea del Verrocchio, Tobias and the Angel — the angel walking the road holding the boy by the hand the whole way, appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him
pictures.name: pd_verrocchio_tobias_and_the_angel

pictures.scene: Matthias Grünewald, The Concert of Angels — the angels kneeling at their viols under the carved canopy playing on and on, then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day
pictures.name: pd_grunewald_the_concert_of_angels

lines.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David.
Hear my cry, O God;
attend to my prayer.
From the ends of the earth I call out to You
whenever my heart is faint.
Lead me to the rock
that is higher than I.
For You have been my refuge,
a tower of strength against the enemy.
Let me dwell in Your tent forever
and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings.
Selah
For You have heard my vows, O God;
You have given me the inheritance
reserved for those who fear Your name.
Increase the days of the king’s life;
may his years span many generations.
May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever;
appoint Your loving devotion
and Your faithfulness to guard him.
Then I will ever sing praise to Your name
and fulfill my vows day by day.
